classes.name: BoardsPage
classes.description:
# Boards Page Class
This class represents the boards list page in the OpenProject application.
Users can view, create, and delete boards from this page.

methods.name: boardTable
methods.description:
Returns the board table component on the boards page, used to read board
names, count boards, and reach individual rows for deletion.
methods.observableState: None — returns a component wrapper without interacting

methods.name: clickCreateBoardButton
methods.description: Clicks the "Create new board" button, opening the board creation form.
methods.observableState: Navigates to the combined board creation form (title, type, Create button)

methods.name: getBoardNameByIndex
methods.description: Gets the name of a board by its position in the list.
methods.prerequisites: The boards page is open and the list has at least `index + 1` boards

classes.name: BoardTableComp
classes.description:
# Board Table Component Class
This class represents a table component that displays a list of boards in the OpenProject application.
It provides methods to interact with the rows of the table.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description:
Reloads the page so the board table shows the latest server-side data.
Useful after creating or deleting a board.
methods.observableState: The page reloads and the board table re-renders with current data

methods.name: getNumberOfRows
methods.description:
Returns the number of rows in the board table, which is the number of boards.
Returns 0 both when the table is absent entirely (all boards deleted) and
when it renders a single "No visible results to display." placeholder row.

methods.name: getRowByIndex
methods.description: Gets a board table row by its zero-based index.
methods.prerequisites: The boards page is open and the table has at least `index + 1` rows

methods.name: isRowForTableWithNameExists
methods.description: Checks whether a row for the board with the specified name exists in the table.

methods.name: getRowByBoardName
methods.description:
Gets the row for a board by its name. When several boards share a name,
`index` selects which of the matches to return. Throws if no row matches,
or if `index` is out of bounds for the matches found.
methods.prerequisites: The boards page is open and a board with this name exists

classes.name: BoardTableRowComp
classes.description:
# Board Table Row Component Class
This class represents a row in the board table on the boards page in the OpenProject application.
It provides methods to interact with the board's details such as name, type, creation date, and delete button.

methods.name: clickDeleteButtonAndAcceptDeletion
methods.description: Clicks the delete link for this board and accepts the confirmation dialog.
methods.prerequisites: The boards list is displayed and this row's board exists
methods.observableState: The board's row is removed from the boards table; the confirmation dialog is auto-accepted and the browser returns to the boards list

classes.name: BoardTypePage
classes.description:
# Board Type Page Class
This class represents the "Create new board" form page in the OpenProject application.
Users fill in a title, choose the board type (Basic is pre-selected), and click Create.

methods.name: fillBoardName
methods.description: Fills in the board name on the creation form.
methods.prerequisites: The board creation form is open
methods.observableState: The Title field contains the given name

methods.name: clickBasicBoardButton
methods.description:
Clicks the Create button to create a Basic board (the pre-selected type)
and returns the resulting board view page.
methods.prerequisites: The board creation form is open and the title has been filled
methods.observableState: The board is created and the browser navigates to the new board's view

classes.name: ListComp
classes.description:
# List Component Class
This class represents a list component within a board in the OpenProject application.

methods.name: fillListName
methods.description: Sets the name of the list, committing the value with Enter.
methods.prerequisites: The list exists on the board
methods.observableState: The list's title shows the new name and the change is persisted

classes.name: NewBoardPage
classes.description:
# New Board Page Class

Represents the board view page in the OpenProject application, where users
manage a board by adding lists and setting the board name.

Notable behaviours:
- The board saves automatically; there is no save action after setting the name.
- Use {@link NewBoardPage.clickBoardsLink} to navigate back to the boards list.

methods.name: getListByIndex
methods.description: Gets a list on the board by its zero-based index.
methods.prerequisites: The board view is open and has at least `index + 1` lists
methods.observableState: None — returns a component wrapper without interacting

methods.name: fillBoardName
methods.description:
Fills the board name textbox and commits the value with Enter.
The board saves automatically — no separate save action is needed.
methods.observableState: The board title shows the new name and is persisted automatically

methods.name: clickAddListToBoardLink
methods.description:
Clicks the "Add list to board" link to append a new list to the board.
Reach the new list afterwards with {@link getListByIndex}.
methods.observableState: A new empty list is appended to the board and becomes interactable

methods.name: clickBoardsLink
methods.description: Clicks the breadcrumb link to navigate back to the boards list page.
methods.observableState: The browser returns to the boards list page showing all boards
